node.statement: Assume the hypotheses of node 1.1.2 and the facts that A is extended t-C*, each P_j is a t-projection, and t<=e_sim. By lem-maincb-stage1-maximality, dim S^A_{P_j}=1 for every j; together with def-one-dimensional-delta-projection this says every P_j is one-dimensional. By lem-maincb-structural-domain-ledger, t=W.K_call*epsilon<=e_sim, and lem-maincb-corner-equivalence then makes j~k iff dim S^A_{P_j,P_k}=1 an equivalence relation. Since J is finite, its equivalence classes form a finite class family C.
